messages:
sara.marketing: Heads-up — noticed a batch of EU inbound leads getting stuck after enrichment. ~20 leads since 08:12 UTC flagged as 'enrichment_failed' and never assigned. Anyone seen this pattern?
aj-bizops: Do we have logs from the enrich webhook? Timeout/failure code?
sara.marketing: HubSpot webhook shows `504 gateway_timeout` from org-enrich for several contact updates. Our round-robin only triggers on contact creation so property-updates are ignored.
miguel-sdr: That explains it. Leads are created, enrichment times out, contact stays unowned. If enrichment later succeeds, RR doesn't run. Can we make RR idempotent on property change?
beth-sales: We'd need an assigner idempotency marker. Proposal: store `last_assigned_by` and `last_assignment_ts`. Routing job should skip if last_assignment_ts within 2m unless `force_assign=true`.
sara.marketing: Minimal short-term fix: run RR on property `hs_enriched=true` for 15-minute canary in EU only. Add `enrichment_attempts` counter to avoid retries loops (max 3). Longer-term: update assignment service to run on both create and enrichment events with idempotency key.
aj-bizops: I'll create a HubSpot workflow to set `hs_enriched=true` when enrichment webhook returns success and toggle routing listener for EU. Can do canary at 09:00 UTC.
miguel-sdr: I'll add an Alerting rule: if >5 unowned leads in SDR queue for 30m, ping #sales-escalations + paging.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canaried feature flag `rr-on-enrichment-eu` scheduled 2025-04-02T09:00:00Z.
beth-sales: Rollback criteria: any duplicate assignments or >10% increase in unowned leads after 1h. Action items: @aj-bizops workflow + webhook mapping, @sara.marketing update routing runbook and KB, @miguel-sdr monitor queues and escalate.
sara.marketing: I'll attach 3 sample lead IDs and logs to the ticket after canary: 780112, 780113, 780124. Thanks all.
